antipatterns.name: SKIP_QA_FOR_INFRASTRUCTURE
antipatterns.description: Skipping visual QA testing for 'infrastructure' or 'scaffold' features
antipatterns.prevention: ALL features require step-05a-qa, even scaffolds. Visual verification catches integration issues.
antipatterns.what_went_wrong: Initially skipped visual testing assuming scaffold didn't need it
antipatterns.lesson: Even scaffolds need browser verification to confirm frontend-backend integration works

antipatterns.name: MANUAL_LEARNING_OUTPUT
antipatterns.description: Writing superficial 09-learn.md without updating actual learning system files
antipatterns.prevention: Step-09-learn MUST update: metrics.json, patterns.json, antipatterns.json in .nomos/learning/
antipatterns.what_went_wrong: Created output file but didn't update learning infrastructure
antipatterns.lesson: Learning extraction requires updating JSON files, not just markdown

antipatterns.name: SKIP_CLEANUP_PROMPT
antipatterns.description: Not asking user about worktree cleanup when auto_mode=false
antipatterns.prevention: When cleanup_mode=false AND auto_mode=false, MUST use AskUserQuestion for cleanup decision
antipatterns.what_went_wrong: Worktree left behind without asking user preference
